On dry ground a record 60 members out of a field of 142 were under 30 minutes and many achieved fast times, writes JEREMY HEMMING. Osborne, a Hertfordshire leisure officer, set a new course record of 24:56 for the 4.8 miles, a reduction of no less than 39 seconds.
A course of treatment for the disorder has worked wonders and as a result, our already upwardly mobile women's road and cross country section has received another boost. Photo: Jeremy Hemming
